comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Primarily a rural Alaska electric utility with hydro generation; telecom is secondary and geography and economics differ.

comps.label: C2

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Diversified holding company dominated by billboards and insurance; fiber broadband is only a small part.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Alaska-focused integrated carrier with large wireless operations; similar services but different market and wireless-driven business.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Rural and small-market fiber and cable broadband, video, voice and tower leasing closely mirror Shentel, though it also owns a wireless carrier.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Owns fiber networks selling consumer and business broadband plus wholesale fiber transport to carriers, matching Shentel's fiber model.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Satellite operator and defense equipment manufacturer; different technology, customers and revenue model from terrestrial fiber broadband.
